simplicity.simpleTitle: Deploy without becoming a platform engineer.
simplicity.simpleDescription: Create an app, deploy source or an image, attach a domain and enable HTTPS. CapRover handles the container, routing and service lifecycle while keeping everyday settings in one dashboard.
simplicity.powerfulTitle: Customize deeply without leaving the platform.
simplicity.powerfulDescription: Most apps never need the escape hatches. When one does, customize its complete NGINX configuration or override native Docker service settings instead of rebuilding your deployment platform around an edge case.

principles.title: How this comparison is maintained
